campaign_name: PR-BR — Second Full 4×10 Synthetic Playability Gate
purpose: Second product-level 4x10 synthetic playability gate after C23-C27. One run; no repair, rerun, human playtest, commit, or push.
executive_summary: Four isolated personas completed 40/40 turns. Manual PASS 8/40 (20%); threshold missed. Contracts: 6 fully correct, 11 partial-but-sufficient, 23 incorrect. Accepted/emitted integrity held, but three confirmed post-contract raw-semantic resolutions, one unsupported consequential identity, 19 other consequential-fact accepts, recurring addressee loss, generic nonresolution, and location-state failure require Decision D: SECOND FULL 4×10 GATE FAILED — ARCHITECTURAL INVARIANT REGRESSION. Human playtest not ready.

validation: Four updated persona descriptions were frozen before the gate.
tooling: Existing validation-only full-gate harness reused without product-behavior changes.

testing.broader: Not run; this cycle is the authorized fresh 4x10 product gate.
testing.runtime_validation: 4 isolated sessions and exactly 10 completed gameplay turns each.
testing.model_runtime_boundary: 4 opening, 40 gameplay initial, 11 retry, 18 interpretation, 40 synthetic-player, 0 evaluator-model calls.
testing.new_regressions: Post-contract semantic closure, consequential authority, addressee continuity, fallback competence, and movement persistence failed.
testing.pre_existing_failures: No historical transcript or targeted phrase was replayed.

decisions_requiring_human_review: Whether the population justifies one final repair, broader redesign, or a different strategy.
Whether declared resolution-contract ownership can be trusted while downstream raw semantics still control output.
PR-BR remains open; human playtest is not authorized.

campaign_specific: One unsupported consequential identity and 19 other consequential-fact accept events.
Twenty-three incorrect contracts; twenty caused visible failure.
C10 location reset after unsupported prose-only exploration.
pre_existing: Working tree was already dirty and is fully frozen in freeze.json.

does_not_prove: Does not authorize C28 or another repair continuation.
Does not prove semantic ownership from telemetry labels alone.
recommended_next_step: External failure-population review. Do not repair, rerun, create C28, start PR-BS, commit, or push from this gate.
